skills.name: Preparing a model cheque or payment order

note.text: A payment form may request a date, payee, amount in figures, amount in words and an authorised signature. Exact layouts and rules differ by institution. Use a fictional classroom model and never supply real account information. The payee is the person or organisation to be paid. Words and figures must agree. A filled model is not a valid payment and does not demonstrate that funds are available. The teacher should confirm the examination's expected format.

sections.heading: Understand the ideas
sections.text: A payment form may request a date, payee, amount in figures, amount in words and an authorised signature. Exact layouts and rules differ by institution. Use a fictional classroom model and never supply real account information. The payee is the person or organisation to be paid. Words and figures must agree. A filled model is not a valid payment and does not demonstrate that funds are available. The teacher should confirm the examination's expected format.

sections.heading: Apply the ideas locally
sections.text: Original model: Classroom model only. Date: {23} October {2026}. Payee: Imaginary School Book Club. Figures: {12500} CFA francs. Words: {words(12500)} CFA francs. Writer: an imaginary authorised signatory. No real account number or signature is included.

sections.heading: Reason and check
sections.text: Identify each field before entering a value. Compare the two amount forms and check the recipient's name. Do not sign for another person or treat a copied sample as a real financial instruction. This exercise assesses form-reading and writing language.

key_words.meaning: the named person or organisation to receive payment
the field stating the payment document's date
words and figures expressing the same value
a person entitled to sign in the stated arrangement
